Profile Tisopurine, an analogue of allopurinol, is an inhibitor of uric acid synthesis. It is used orally in the treatment of disorders associated with hyperuricaemia (p.552), including gout, in doses of 100 to 400 mg daily. Rasburicase is a recombinant form of the enzyme urate oxidase. Adverse Effects The most serious adverse effects of rasburicase involve hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, rashes, bronchospasm, rhinitis, urticaria, hypotension, dyspnoea, and chest pain and tightness.
